question: In the DX-Scorecard MBR builder, a KPI is "Carried" when the data pull returns no fresh value and value/status are carried from the previous published MBR; how is "no fresh value" detected at pull time for a wired KPI (collection failure, empty result, or unchanged value), and is the Carried flag cleared once the user manually edits that KPI's value?
recommendation: "No fresh value" is detected purely by the ABSENCE of a source reading for that KPI id in the current pull (buildSnapshot's `if (!fromSource) return kpi;`): both a collection failure (the source throws and is swallowed in runSources, contributing zero readings) and an empty result (the source emits no reading for that id) collapse to the same missing map entry, so the KPI carries value/status/insight forward. "Unchanged value" is NOT a carry trigger — if a source emits any reading, even one identical to the prior value, it is applied as fresh and clears the badge. And the Carried flag is NOT cleared by a manual value edit: the client's `editKpi` never touches the `carried` set, so only a refresh (refreshOne/refreshAll/seedFresh) clears the "carried over" badge — this is a latent bug where a manually-overwritten carried KPI keeps showing the badge.
supporting_points: Pull-time detection is presence/absence only: scripts/build-snapshot.ts builds `freshBySource` from the readings the sources returned this run, and each KPI does `const fromSource = eligible ? freshBySource.get(kpi.id) : undefined; if (!fromSource) return kpi;` — carrying forward the reconciled prior reading. runSources() wraps each source in try/catch and logs 'FAILED', so a throwing source (collection failure) simply yields no readings, identical to an empty result. There is no value-comparison, so an unchanged-but-emitted value is treated as fresh, not carried.

The Carried badge is client state in src/views/MbrBuilderView.tsx: a `carried` Set of KPI ids seeded by valuedIds()/seededCarried() (unwired KPIs with a value are carried; wired KPIs are fresh). refreshOne() does `carried.delete(kpiId)` and refreshAll()/seedFresh() re-seed via seededCarried(), so refresh is the ONLY path that clears the badge.

editKpi() (the handler behind both the unwired value input and the insight/status controls) only calls setSnapshot + saveSnapshot and never mutates `carried`; the value-edit test (MbrBuilderView.test.tsx ~line 238) asserts persistence but never asserts the badge clears — so after a user manually edits a carried KPI's value, the 'carried over' badge remains until an actual refresh.
